import hashlib, json, re
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin

source_url = 'https://developers.google.com/merchant/api/reference/rest/products_v1/accounts.productInputs'
source = Path('products/services/catalogue-variant-group-check/raw/merchant-api-product-inputs.html')
raw = source.read_bytes()
pattern = re.compile(r'item[ _-]?group[ _-]?id|product attributes|variant', re.I)

class Extract(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.hidden = 0
        self.parts = []
        self.links = []
        self.anchor = None

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in {'script', 'style'}:
            self.hidden += 1
        if tag == 'a' and not self.hidden:
            self.anchor = (dict(attrs).get('href', ''), [])

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in {'script', 'style'} and self.hidden:
            self.hidden -= 1
        if tag == 'a' and self.anchor:
            href, label = self.anchor
            label = ' '.join(' '.join(label).split())
            url = urljoin(source_url, href)
            if href and url.startswith(('https://developers.google.com/', 'https://support.google.com/')) and pattern.search(label + ' ' + url):
                self.links.append({'label': label, 'url': url})
            self.anchor = None

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.hidden:
            self.parts.append(data)
            if self.anchor:
                self.anchor[1].append(data)

parser = Extract()
parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
text = ' '.join(' '.join(parser.parts).split())
field = re.compile(r'item[ _-]?group[ _-]?id', re.I)
contexts = list(dict.fromkeys(text[max(0, m.start()-160):m.end()+220] for m in field.finditer(text)))
links = list({(entry['label'], entry['url']): entry for entry in parser.links}.values())
report = {'source': source_url, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'field_contexts': contexts[:12], 'official_link_pointers': links[:15], 'scope': 'Visible text and first-party link pointers from one saved API reference. A field declaration alone establishes no CSV acceptance criterion.'}
out = source.parent.parent / 'director-api-field-extract.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == report
print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False))
